node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT (seed 574) and, on the per-symbol frame, ETHUSDT (seed 575) 1m series of 800 bars to the forming bar 14:05 UTC; tick and qty step from the recorded instrument fixture; volumes, deltas, trades, prices, the thresholds' example bounds and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No account data, key or balance. C-2.11 (R-1): the strip reads the live public trade stream on demo and live alike; no DEMO / LIVE badge and no environment control appears; nothing on this board differs by environment.
